[LNUL.9.3] **No new ULP surface, by short-circuit.** A `null` operand
short-circuits the arithmetic/comparison (the float op is never executed), so
null adds **no new ULP surface and no transcendental** — only integer tag
compares ([LNUL.6.1]). WCET-bounded.

idris.name: lnul_9_3__null_before_the_divisor
idris.note: The short-circuit: a null operand on either side of any arithmetic operator of the fragment is null and the operation, a zero divisor under /, // or % included, is never performed; the Float operation is short-circuited the same way (`lnul_4_1__arith_null_left` / `_right`, over every operand). Comparisons are `lnul_4_1__cmp_null_left` / `_right`; the ULP and WCET consequences are not modelled.
